raw_segments.text: Apollo, O monsters loathed of all, O scorn of gods, he that hath bound me loose.
A cure there is, yea, many a plan that can unbind the chain.
But when the thirsty dust sucks up man's blood once shed in death, he shall arise no more.
No chant nor charm for this my sire hath wrought.
All else there is, he molds and shifts at will, not scant of strength nor breath, whate'er
